decisive_items: Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities
hyperkeratosis, spinous cell vacuolization, and vesicles in the epidermis
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1
response.rationale: R1 uniquely spans the clinical, histologic, and genetic axes: congenital vesiculobullous erythematous eruption, epidermolytic vacuolization with vesicles, and KRT1 mutation. R2 is essentially the same entity but its raw support is limited to histology and genetics and lacks the early clinical bullous/erythematous distribution; C1 is only an etiology-restated completion of R2 with no independent raw clinical or histopathologic evidence.

rejected.why: Only raw support is the KRT1 mutation span shared with R1/R2; as an append-only completion of R2 it adds no independent clinical or histopathologic raw evidence and cannot independently stand as a diagnosis.
